location_exception_reason: Portable garages are manufactured products with standardised specifications (frame material, cover type, dimensions, weight capacity). Location of manufacture or seller does not alter the product's functional attributes or buyer decision criteria. No GI protection or regional origin designation applies.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer') in portable garage titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Portable Garage Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title; the business relationship is not part of what is being sold.
